articles.title_zh: 线性马斯克-GS:稳定马斯克的重要性 3D高斯克平板
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)可以进行实时小说取景合成,但通过适应性分解而产生上百万个原始人,从而导致大量存储上浮. LP-3DGS等学习-掩埋方法通过给每个高斯人一个可以学习的面具来识别和prune冗余原始人来解决这个问题。 然而,我们确定这一范式的局限性:Gumbel-Sigmoid活化的陡峭坡度驱使口罩-训练窗口内的口罩值达到极限,在重要性排名得到稳定之前,产生了急剧的双模式分布,这种分布再也无法可靠地从中恢复. 我们提议LinearMask-GS,它用线性增量活化取代了Gumbel-Sigmoid,在整个口罩训练中将口罩值保持在中信任度制度,产生稳定而单式口罩分布,其排位重要。 在Mip-NERF 360上,我们的方法在保持或提高渲染质量的同时,分别比3DGS和LP-3DGS实现3.6x和1.6x高斯的还原. 对于户外场景,其产量为1.6x还原(从2.18M到1.36M),在PSNR(+0.38分贝),SSIM(+0.025)和LPIPS(-0.029)方面都有显著的增益.

articles.title: A statistical approach to bias in zero-shot learning: the lens of handwriting recognition
articles.content: Generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) has emerged as an important paradigm for visual recognition systems that must generalize to classes that were not observed during training. Traditional GZSL techniques are limited by their applicability to a relatively small number of such unseen classes, scalability beyond which is challenging due to its well-known misclassification bias towards classes observed during training. In this work, we investigate the GZSL paradigm through the lens of zero-shot handwritten word recognition over extremely large vocabularies. We propose a statistical approach to rectifying this bias, which views any classical GZSL feature learner as a black box mechanism whose intrinsic bias in identifying the training status (seen vs. unseen) of a typical data point we aim to correct, similar to an out of distribution inferential problem. Our method leverages a simple two-stage hierarchical architecture, combining a classical GZSL blackbox in the first stage and an ensemble of lightweight Monte Carlo bias-correctors in the second. Once debiased, the classification of test data is undertaken only restricted to its predicted training status via well-founded statistical methods (eg nearest neighbour, logistic regression and random forests). We achieve relative accuracy improvements of over 20% in the classification of unseen words compared to established techniques. A key outcome is that word recognition over large scale vocabularies is amenable to a much lower dimensional representation (~15 dimensions). Our approach is underpinned by mathematical analysis that captures the essence of the statistical approach to bias correction. Our approach to bias rectification can be combined in a turn-key fashion with any classical GZSL learner as a blackbox, thereby suggesting a wide scope of applicability of this method for a wide variety of GZSL implementations in different domains.

articles.title_zh: 零镜头学习中偏向的统计方法:笔迹识别的透镜
articles.content_zh: 通用零发学习(GZSL)已成为视觉识别系统的重要范例,必须被通用到培训期间没有观察到的班级. 传统的GZSL技术由于适用于为数较少的这种看不见的班级而受到限制,超出这些班级的可扩展性具有挑战性,因为它对培训期间观察到的班级有众所周知的分级偏差。 在这部作品中,我们通过零镜头手写字识别的镜头来调查GZSL范式,比起极其庞大的词汇. 我们建议一种统计方法来纠正这种偏见,它把任何古典的GZSL特征学习者视为一个黑盒机制,其内在的偏见在于确定我们力求纠正的典型数据点的培训状况(见与不见的),这类似于一个出自分布推断的问题。 我们的方法利用了一个简单的两阶段分级架构,结合了第一阶段的古典GZSL黑盒和第二阶段的轻量级蒙特卡洛偏差修正器的组合. 一旦消除了偏见,测试数据的分类只能通过有根据的统计方法(如最近的相邻地区、后勤回归和随机森林)限于预测的培训状况。 与既定技术相比,我们实现了隐形词分类的相对精确度提高20%以上。 一个关键的结果是,大尺度词汇中的单词识别可被更低的维度(~15维)所接受. 我们的方法以数学分析为基础,这种分析抓住了对偏差修正的统计方法的实质。 我们纠正偏见的方法可以统包式地与任何古典GZSL学习者作为黑匣子结合,从而表明这种方法广泛适用于不同领域的各种GZSL执行.

articles.title: Automatic Reproducible Camera Intrinsic Calibration
articles.content: Accurate camera intrinsic calibration is fundamental to robot perception, and the accuracy depends on the quality of the collected images. However, existing target-based calibration methods often require the practitioner to manually filter out high-quality images and to specify an appropriate radial distortion order. This paper presents a fully automatic intrinsic calibration pipeline that determines both from the collected data. We adopt an iterative rejection scheme that estimates parameters on a candidate image set and removes views whose mean residual exceeds a multiple of the median. Crucially, this process runs independently under each candidate distortion order, so that the retained image set is consistent with the residual scale of that order. Further, the distortion order is selected on held-out images, with the intrinsics and distortion fixed and only the board pose re-estimated, ensuring that an added coefficient is supported by independent observations. Finally, we integrate both steps into an interactive calibration tool that supports full-pipeline data inspection and parameter estimation. Experiments on our own camera data and five public real-world datasets show that image filtering reduces the held-out reprojection error by 25\%, the order selection further by 5\%, achieving the lowest held-out mean among four compared configurations without manual image selection. We will release the code and data to facilitate future research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动可复制 相机内置校正
articles.content_zh: 精确相机的内在校正对机器人的感知至关重要,准确性取决于所收集图像的质量. 然而,现有的以目标为基础的校准方法往往要求从业者手动过滤出高质量的图像并指定适当的射线扭曲顺序. 本文件提供了一个完全自动的内在校正管道,从所收集的数据中确定两者。 我们通过一个迭代拒绝方案,估计一个候选图像集的参数,并去除其平均剩余值超过中位数倍的视图。 关键是,这个过程在每一个候选扭曲顺序下独立运行,这样所保留的图像集与该顺序的剩余比例一致. 此外,在被搁置的图像上选择了扭曲顺序,固定了内在和扭曲,只有棋盘再作估计,确保增加的系数得到独立观察的支持. 最后,我们把这两个步骤纳入一个互动校正工具,支持全管数据检查和参数估计。 在我们自己的相机数据和5个公共现实世界数据集上的实验显示,图像过滤可以将被搁置的再预测出错减少25××××,顺序选择进一步减少5××××,在没有人工图像选择的情况下在四个比较配置中实现被搁置的最低平均值. 我们将公布代码和数据以促进未来的研究。

articles.title: Elastoformer: Enabling Dynamic Adaptivity via Elastic Model Transformation
articles.content: EdgeAI systems are increasingly employing computer vision applications to enable intelligent, on-device decision-making in real-time. However, these deployments face highly dynamic operational conditions, with fluctuating constraints on latency, power availability, and memory resources. Deep Neural Networks (DNN), which follow fixed computational execution flows, lack the flexibility to adapt to such variability, resulting in inefficient and suboptimal performance in edge scenarios. This underscores the need for architectures that are not only efficient but also dynamically scalable at runtime. In this paper, we propose Elastoformer: A framework that transforms conventional neural networks (NN) into Elastic NN capable of real-time elastic inference. Unlike the conventional bag-of-models approach, which requires maintaining multiple independent models for different operating conditions, Elastoformer offers a single, modular solution that dynamically switches between multiple modes of operation at runtime, adapting efficiently to the changing computational budgets of edge devices without the overhead of managing separate models. Experiments reveal that our framework achieves up to 85% reduction in computation FLOPs, 50% reduction in latency and 76% reduction in memory overhead, while showcasing the architecture agnostic nature of the framework across both Vision Transformers and CNNs. Our code is available at https://github.com/sudaksh14/Elastoformer.

articles.title_zh: 埃拉斯托福尔: 通过弹性模型转换实现动态适应性
articles.content_zh: EdgeAI系统正越来越多地使用计算机视觉应用软件,以便能够实时地进行智能、在线决策。 然而,这些部署面临高度动态的作业条件,对耐用性、可用电力和内存资源的制约波动不定。 遵循固定计算执行流量的深神经网络(DNN)缺乏适应这种可变性的灵活性,导致边缘情景中性能低效和不理想. 这突出表明,需要不仅高效而且可在运行时动态扩展的架构。 在本文中,我们提出"Elastoformer:一个将常规神经网络(NN)转化为能实时弹性推导的"弹性NN"的框架. 与传统的包式模型方法不同,需要为不同的运行条件维持多个独立模型,Elastoformer提供了一个单一的模块化解决方案,在运行时在多个运行模式之间动态地切换,高效地适应边缘设备不断变化的计算预算,而无需管理单独模型的间接费用. 实验显示,我们的框架在计算FLOP时实现了高达85%的减少,延后率减少了50%,内存间接费用减少了76%,同时在视觉变形器和CNN上展示了框架的不可知性。 我们的代码见https://github.com/sudaksh14/Elastoformer。

articles.title: Beyond Similarity: Foundation Models as an Efficient Backbone for Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval
articles.content: Composed video retrieval (CoVR) searches a gallery for the target video that realizes a natural-language modification of a source clip. However, at gallery scale, this creates a fundamental tension: compact embeddings enable efficient, reusable search but can miss the transient actions, state changes, and subtle constraints that demand fine-grained video reasoning, whereas applying large multimodal models uniformly sacrifices scalability. To address these limitations, we propose that frozen foundation models should instead occupy complementary roles, with inference depth adapted to query difficulty. Based on this premise, we introduce \methodname{}, a framework for training-free \methodexpansion{}. Specifically, a composed-query embedding first searches reusable video-only gallery representations; uncertain queries undergo bounded reranking and candidate expansion; ambiguous edits trigger target-description generation; and only close leading candidates reach multimodal verification. To support these roles, frame selection, spatial resolution, and time cues are adapted to each stage. Across complete target-gallery evaluations, our method reaches state-of-the-art performance among training-free approaches, with 89.55 and 93.43 R@1 on Dense-WebVid-CoVR and CoVR-R, respectively (with more than +35\% and +25\% absolute margins to the closest counterpart). These results show that adaptively orchestrating foundation-model capabilities can combine scalable retrieval with fine-grained reasoning without task-specific training. The source code and all relevant guidelines are available on https://github.com/demidovd98/CoVRAGE.

articles.title_zh: 超越相似性:作为培训-免费视频检索的高效后骨的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 由编成的视频检索(CoVR)搜索一个画廊,用于实现源片段自然语言修改的目标视频. 然而,在画廊规模上,这造成了一种根本性的紧张:紧凑的嵌入可以有效、可再用地搜索,但可能错过瞬间行动、状态变化和微妙的制约,这些制约需要精细的视频推理,而采用大型多式联运模式则统一牺牲可扩展性。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议,被冻结的基础模型应发挥互补作用,推论深度应适应查询困难。 基于这个前提,我们引入了\方法名\\\,一个无培训\方法扩展\\\\的框架. 具体地说,嵌入了首个搜索可重复使用的只限视频的画廊;不确定的询问经过了限定的重新排序和候选人扩展;模糊的编辑触发了目标描述生成;只有接近领先的候选人才能达到多模式验证. 为了支持这些角色,框架选择,空间分辨率,和时间提示被适应每个阶段. 通过完整的目标采集评价,我们的方法在无培训方法中达到了最先进的性能,在Dense-WebVid-CoVR和CoVR-R上分别有89.55和93.43 R@1(与最接近的对应方的绝对边距超过+35+和+25++)。 这些结果表明,适应性地组织基础-模型能力可以将可伸缩回取与精细的推理结合,而无需接受特定任务的培训. 源代码和所有相关指南可查阅https://github.com/demidovd98/CoVRAGE.

articles.title: What Makes Adversarial Examples Transfer Across Deepfake Detectors?
articles.content: Deepfake detectors remain vulnerable to transfer-based black-box attacks, in which adversarial examples are generated on a source surrogate model and transferred to a target model, unknown to the attacker. Yet how source--target compatibility shapes attack success remains poorly understood. Prior studies evaluate limited detector pools and rarely disentangle architectural from training factors. We conduct a controlled evaluation of adversarial transferability across 60 detectors spanning six backbones, two pretraining regimes, and five training-data configurations, using two attack procedures: AutoAttack (AA) and the Carlini--Wagner attack with Expectation over Transformation (CW--EOT). Matched comparisons reveal significantly higher transfer when source and target share an exact backbone, architecture family, pretraining regime, or training data. This compatibility structure is attack-dependent: exact backbone compatibility has the largest effect under AA, whereas shared pretraining and training data have the largest effects under CW--EOT. When transfer is averaged across non-target sources, mean attack success rate (ASR) is $7.21\%$ under AA and $19.52\%$ under CW--EOT. By contrast, a multi-source oracle combining both attacks attains a \(64.48\%\) mean ASR after excluding exact backbone and training-data matches, showing that source averaging can substantially understate target vulnerability. We release 240,000 adversarially perturbed images, complete pairwise transfer results, detector configurations, and evaluation code. These findings establish source--target compatibility and source-model selection as central dimensions of credible transfer-based black-box robustness evaluation.

articles.title_zh: 是什么让反常例子 跨越深假探测器传输?
articles.content_zh: 深假探测器仍然容易受到基于转移的黑匣子攻击,其中在源替代模型上生成对抗性实例并被转移到目标模型上,被攻击者所未知. 然而,对源-目标相容性形状如何攻击成功仍知之甚少。 以前的研究评价了有限的探测器池,很少将建筑与培训因素分开. 我们利用两个攻击程序,即AutoAttack(AA)和 " 卡利尼-瓦格纳 " 以期望在转型后进行攻击(CW-EOT),对跨越六个主干线的60个探测器、两个训练前系统和五个培训数据配置的对抗性可转移性进行控制评价。 相匹配的比较表明,当源和目标共享精确的骨干、结构家族、培训前制度或培训数据时,转移量要高得多。 这种相容性结构依赖攻击:精确的主干相容性在AA下具有最大的效果,而共享的预训和培训数据在CW-EOT下具有最大的效果. 如果在非目标来源之间平均转移,平均攻击成功率(ASR)在AA之下为7.21美元;在CW-EOT之下为19.52美元。 相形之下,将两种攻击结合起来的多源甲骨文在排除精确的骨干和培训数据匹配之后,会达到\(64.48\%\)的ASR,表明源平均值可以大大低估目标脆弱性。 我们释放出24万个对角扰动的图像, 完整的双向传输结果, 探测器配置, 和评价代码。 这些调查结果将源-目标相容性和源-模型选择确定为可信传输的黑箱强性评价的核心层面.

articles.title: From Few-Shot Segmentation to Clinician-in-the-Loop Medical Image Analysis
articles.content: Few-shot medical image segmentation (FSMIS) seeks to delineate unseen structures from a small support set, but its standard formulation fixes task-defining evidence before inference. This assumption is fragile when query cases exhibit acquisition shift, atypical pathology, ambiguous boundaries, or poor image quality. Prototype learning, cross-domain matching, interactive segmentation, uncertainty estimation, test-time adaptation, and promptable foundation models address parts of this problem, yet have not been jointly evaluated under a common model of expert attention and clinical risk. This Perspective reframes FSMIS as a sequential clinician-model decision problem with a static support budget $K$ and a distinct interaction budget $B$. At each step, a system accepts the current segmentation, requests feedback, or defers to full expert review. Queries vary in location and modality and are selected by response-conditioned net expected value of information; clinician-provided feedback informs bounded adaptation only after prespecified provenance, consistency, and safety gates. The framework separates distributional atypicality from predicted clinical failure and treats clinician responses as informative but fallible observations. We synthesize the transition from few-shot and cross-domain segmentation to interactive and selective adaptation, delineate the integration gap, and define four research directions with falsifiable hypotheses. Evaluation spans external-domain calibration, quality-effort trade-offs, reader studies, and prospective workflow assessment. The central claim is not that interaction alone resolves domain shift, but that scarce expert attention should be allocated only when it is expected to reduce clinically relevant risk.

articles.title_zh: 从少发热分片到临床医生在环行医疗图像分析
articles.content_zh: 很少镜头的医学图像分解(FSMIS)试图从一个小的辅助集中分辨出看不见的结构,但其标准配方在推论前就确定了任务界定的证据。 当查询案件显示获取转变、非典型病理、界限模糊或图像质量差时,这种假设是脆弱的。 原型学习,跨域相配,交互分解,不确定性估计,测试时间适应,以及可迅速的基础模型,都解决了部分问题,但还没有在专家关注和临床风险的共同模型下联合评价. 这一视角将FSMIS重新界定为连续的临床医生模型决策问题,其固定支助预算为一美元,互动预算为一美元。 在每一步骤,一个系统都接受目前的分解,要求反馈,或推迟到专家全面审查。 查询在地点和方式上各不相同,根据反应条件信息的净预期值进行选择;临床医生提供的反馈只有在事先指明出处、一致性和安全门后才能通报有限度的适应情况。 该框架将分布性非典型性与预测的临床衰竭区分开来,并将临床医生的反应视为信息性但可谬误的观察. 我们综合了从几发和跨域分解向互动和有选择地适应的过渡,划定了集成差距,并用可伪造的假说定义了四个研究方向. 评价涉及外部领域校准、质量-努力取舍、读者研究和预期工作流程评估。 中心主张的不是单是相互作用就能解决域位转移,而是只有在预期减少临床相关风险时才应分配稀缺的专家注意力.

articles.title: VLX-VR: An Agentic-Aware Video Reasoning Model
articles.content: Real-world video understanding requires integrating visual, audio, textual, and temporal evidence distributed across a video. Yet many pipelines use a fixed video context and single-pass inference, limiting adaptive evidence acquisition when observations are incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting. We present VLX-VR, an agentic-aware video reasoning model trained within a video reasoning framework defined by a Think--Memory--Observation loop. At each step, VLX-VR determines the needed evidence, invokes read_memory or write_memory, incorporates the returned Observation, and decides whether to continue or produce the task output. We train VLX-VR with multimodal data, including videos and agent trajectories, using reinforcement learning to learn evidence acquisition, memory use, and termination. On MINERVA, VLX-VR achieves state-of-the-art performance among the models included in our comparison, with 78.79% accuracy. Under the original three duration groups, its accuracies are 76.70%, 78.73%, and 80.92%, with a cross-duration accuracy variance of 2.97~$\mathrm{pp}^2$. On correctly answered samples, 96.20% of VLX-VR's reasoning traces are consistent with the MINERVA reference reasoning traces and the evidence described by them, while approximately 75.80% of all evaluated samples satisfy both answer correctness and this evidence-grounded trace criterion. These results show strong performance and broadly stable behavior across durations, while counting, state changes, causal reasoning, and spatial perception remain challenging.

articles.title: Putting Captions to the Test: Evaluating Video Caption Quality through Multiple-Choice Question Answering
articles.content: Evaluating video captioning remains a critical challenge for Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs). Existing metrics primarily rely on matching generated text against ground-truth references. This paradigm suffers from the ``one-to-many'' nature of video description, where high-quality captions are often penalized for lexical mismatches or valid shifts in visual focus. Furthermore, such assessments are typically one-dimensional, failing to provide a fine-grained analysis of caption quality. To address this, we redefine caption quality through the lens of information fidelity: A caption must maximize the coverage of salient visual information while ensuring strict factuality. We introduce CapQuiz, a novel reference-free benchmark that assesses captions based on their utility in answering human-verified, fine-grained, multiple-choice questions derived from the video. CapQuiz features a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 question types (spanning Descriptive and Inferential categories) across 24 diverse video domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CapQuiz correlates significantly better with human judgments than existing metrics and offers interpretable insights into model performance.

articles.title_zh: 将标题放入测试中:通过多选题回答评价视频标题质量
articles.content_zh: 评估视频字幕仍然是视觉大语言模型(VLLM)的关键挑战. 现有的衡量标准主要依靠将生成的文本与地面真实的参考文献相匹配。 这种范式因视频描述的"一对多"性质而受到影响,其中高品质的字幕往往会因为词汇错配或视觉焦点的有效转变而受到惩罚. 此外,这种评估一般是一维的,未能对标题质量进行精细分析。 为了解决这个问题,我们通过信息忠诚的镜头重新定义标题质量: 标题必须最大限度地覆盖显著的视觉信息,同时确保严格的事实性。 我们引入了CapQuiz, 一个全新的无参考基准, 根据其在回答由视频产生的经人验证的,精细的,多选择的问题时的效用来评估字幕。 CapQuiz有一个分层次的分类,由10个问题类型(扩展描述和推断类别)组成,涉及24个不同的视频领域。 广泛的实验表明,CapQuiz与人类判断的关联性大大高于现有的衡量标准,并对模型性能提供了可解释的见解。

articles.title: Vague2Detect: Handling Ambiguous Prompts in Knowledge-Based Open-World Detection
articles.content: Real-world detectors must often interpret functional or ambiguous prompts, yet conventional models such as YOLO remain restricted to fixed class lists. Even open-vocabulary models like YOLO-World frequently misalign vague language with the intended objects. Building on our prior work Commonsense-Guided Open-World Object Detection Using LLMs and Visual-Semantic Matching, we address YOLO-World's limitations in grounding task-driven queries. We propose Vague2Detect, a hybrid pipeline in which a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT retrieves candidates from a structured household Knowledge Base (KB), and YOLO-World verifies their presence in the image. For prompts outside the KB, a large language model (GPT-3.5-turbo) generates candidate descriptions, dynamically expanding the KB to cover novel concepts. On a benchmark of household scenes using custom images and an Open Images V7 subset, YOLO-World alone achieves only 32% Vague Prompt Success Rate (VPSR), the ability to map ambiguous queries to correct detections. In contrast, Vague2Detect improves performance to 61% VPSR with high precision, and up to 85% when augmented with GPT fallback.

articles.title_zh: 模糊2 检测:处理基于知识的开放-世界检测中的模糊提示
articles.content_zh: 现实世界的探测器必须经常解释功能或模棱两可的提示,而YOLO等常规模型仍被限制在固定的类列表. 即使是YOLO-World等开放-vocabulary模型,也经常将模糊的语言与预定对象错配. 以我们以前的工作为基础,利用LLMS和可视-语义比对方法,解决YOLO-World在基于任务驱动的查询方面的局限性。 我们提议Vague2 Detect(Vague2 Detect)是一个混合管道,一个经过微调的判罚-BERT从结构化的家庭知识库(KB)中取出候选人,YOLO-World验证他们在图像中的存在. 对于KB以外的提示,一款大型语言模型(GPT-3.5-turbo)生成候选描述,动态地将KB扩展为涵盖新概念. 在使用自定义图像和一个开放图像 V7 子集的家庭场景基准上,YOLO-World 单独实现的只有32%的Vague快速成功率(VPSR),即能够映射出模糊的查询来纠正检测. 相形之下,Vague2 Detect能以高精度将性能提升至61%的VPSR,再用GPT回落来增强时可提升至85%.

articles.title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations via Class-Wise Adaptive Modality Fusion and Affective Geometry
articles.content: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) requires integrating heterogeneous textual, audio, and visual cues while accounting for conversational context and emotional dynamics. We extend the Self-Distillation Transformer architecture for ERC with appearance+geometry visual representations, class-wise adaptive modality fusion, and a valence-arousal prior for affective transitions. On the MELD and IEMOCAP datasets, geometry-enhanced visual representations improve weighted F1 by 0.27 and 4.36 points over appearance-only features, respectively, while class-wise adaptive fusion provides further gains of 0.17 and 0.25 points over the original softmax gate. The valence-arousal prior yields targeted improvements of 0.30 and 0.74 accuracy points on emotionally shifted utterances while preserving performance on stable turns. These results indicate that structured facial cues, emotion-dependent modality weighting, and affective geometry provide complementary benefits for multimodal ERC.

articles.title_zh: 通过 Class-Wise 适应性运动融合和亲缘几何在交谈中识别多式情感
articles.content_zh: 对话中的情感识别(ERC)需要融合多彩的文字、音频和视觉提示,同时考虑对话的背景和情感动态。 我们扩展了ERC的自旋变形器架构, 其外观+地测量视觉表现, 类的适应性模式聚变, 以及先于感官过渡的活性-激发。 在MELD和IEMOCAP数据集上,几何增强的可视化能分别将加权F1比外观仅能特性提高0.27分和4.36分,而分级的适应性聚变能则比原来的软max门提供0.17分和0.25分的进一步增益. 在情绪转变的言论上,有针对性地提高0.30和0.74的准确度,同时在平稳转弯时保持性能。 这些结果表明,结构化的面部提示、情感依赖模式的加权和有影响几何学为多模式的ERC提供了互补的好处。

articles.title: IdeaAMBIG: Benchmarking Implementation-Critical Gaps in Research-Idea Specifications
articles.content: A research idea may be novel, coherent, and scientifically plausible, yet its proposed method may remain insufficiently specified for faithful implementation. We study the codification readiness of implementation-facing research-method specifications, defined by whether they provide sufficient methodological information for a competent implementer or coding agent to construct the intended method without unsupported assumptions. We construct evidence-grounded specifications and their supported resolutions from papers, codebases, issue threads, and reproduction artifacts. We introduce IdeaAMBIG, a benchmark of 660 evidence-grounded instances: 163 real-world gaps from reproducibility reports and GitHub issues, and 497 controlled synthetic gaps injected into codification-ready references. IdeaAMBIG evaluates three capabilities: codification-readiness assessment, defect localization, and clarification action generation. Defect localization receives only the specification, whereas clarification additionally receives the annotated defect. Across 13 LLMs, the best model achieves 9.6% Macro Defect Recovery Rate on real-world instances but 80.6% Macro Clarification Action Success Rate when given the defect. In an oracle study, supplying the gold resolution raises the downstream codification-ready rate from 14% to 98%. Across all evaluated models, defect localization is the main bottleneck, with stronger clarification given the defect.
